hooks.text: A Roman emperor wrote this to himself. It was never meant to be read.
The most powerful man in the Roman world, in his private journal:
Seneca wrote this almost 2,000 years ago. It's about you.
Epictetus was a slave. This is what he taught.
Read this if people are testing your patience today.
Save this for the day everything goes wrong.
If your mind is racing right now, read this.
You have less time than you think.
Most people will scroll past this. Don't.
This is what real Stoicism sounds like.
You needed to hear this today.

ctas.text: Send this to someone who needs it today.
Which line hit hardest? Comment below.
Follow for real Stoic wisdom, daily.

rules.hook_rules: hook must match the item's author/themes if it has constraints; never the same hook twice in a row; same hook+CTA pair not within 7 days
rules.honesty: hooks make no claims the item cannot back up (e.g. 'Roman emperor' only on Marcus Aurelius items)
